title: 🎃 THE LAST BIRTHDAY — HALLOWEEN RELEASES ARE HERE!
author: Due-Nature9853
selftext:
​

Three stories. One terrible past.

Enter Candlewick’s Celebration Palace in my indie psychological horror series!

🎂 The Last Birthday (1983) — $1.99

🩸 The Last Birthday: Prologue — $3.99

🔥 Before the Flames DLC — $4.99

Explore a mysterious birthday party, uncover the tragedy of 1973, and discover the secrets behind Mr. Morrow.

The main game also has a free demo!

🎮 The Prologue supports PS5 DualSense controllers on Windows PC.

Start here: https://christine-890.itch.io/the-last-birthday-1983

Happy Halloween! Would you dare to return to Candlewick’s? 🎂
